title: model_worker raises error
body:

linked_prs.title: Fix model_worker error
linked_prs.body:

## Why are these changes needed?

Fix the bug that `model_worker` will raise the error `local variable 'i' referenced before assignment` in some case.

## Related issue number (if applicable)

<!-- For example: "Closes #1234" -->
Closes #2382

- [x] I've included any doc changes needed.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves an error in the `model_worker` component of an LLM-based system, specifically related to the `generate_stream` function. This aligns with the "LLM operation issues" category, particularly under "Incorrect model output handlers" due to the unhandled `UnboundLocalError`.
